title: Di-Quan Schafar Hunt violent-offenders normalization pass

data.research_question: Does the filmed July 2026 Charlotte assault and public criminal-history context support inclusion of Di-Quan Schafar Hunt in the violent-offenders dataset?
data.method: Locate the viral video/reposts, corroborate subject identity and current arrest through CMPD-linked local reporting, distinguish arrests from convictions, separately record a prior adjudicated case supported by court-record-based reporting, and omit victim identifiers.
classification_rules: Include a named alleged offender when a violent incident is supported by video plus law-enforcement-based reporting.
Do not equate arrests or charges with convictions.
Record prior adjudications only when source support distinguishes the plea or conviction from an arrest.
Do not create victim person records or expose victim identifiers.

findings.finding: A social-media video captured the July 30, 2026 Charlotte assault attributed by police to Hunt.
Hunt was arrested Aug. 6, 2026, with police announcing an assault-with-a-deadly-weapon charge; current adjudication remains unresolved in the cited reporting.
Local reporting says arrest records show at least nine arrests from October 2023 through December 2025; these are not represented as nine convictions.
Court-record-based reporting documents a March 18, 2026 plea in a December 2025 case and a time-served sentence after 89 days in jail.
